name: quioteframework/replay
description: Record → replay → regression test: an effect ledger and per-subsystem recording/stub seams (database, HTTP client, cache, queue, env) for Quiote.

suggest.quioteframework/propulsion: Enables Quiote\Replay\Db\PropulsionQueryRecorder, an effect-ledger recorder for Propulsion's own query observer seam.
suggest.doctrine/dbal: Enables Quiote\Replay\Db\DoctrineRecordingMiddleware, an effect-ledger recorder for Doctrine DBAL's own driver middleware seam.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/replay/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
